sourceTitle: Metabolism-Informed Bioreactor Model for Transferring Knowledge from Fed-batch to Continuous Biomanufacturing
sourceAbstract: Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells remain the dominant platform for monoclonal antibody (mAb) manufacturing, and rising demand is pushing the industry from fed-batch toward continuous operation. Continuous cultures promise sustained high cell densities and volumetric productivities, but their operation depends on reliable real-time monitoring, prediction and control. Limited intracellular observability and sparse extracellular measurements hinder this, leaving a persistent gap between mechanistic understanding and predictive deployment. Here we describe a metabolism-informed model for mAb production that embeds reactor- and intracellular-level mass balances directly within a learning architecture, while deliberately avoiding predefined kinetic rate laws and explicit steady-state assumptions. Because conservation relationships remain invariant across operating modes, this formulation provides a principled structural prior for cross-regime generalisation, positioning the model as a soft sensor for continuous bioprocesses: inferring unmeasured intracellular fluxes and one-step ahead forecasting extracellular concentrations to support process monitoring and control. Benchmarking two metabolic network sizes and three metabolic optimisation strategies, concentration predictions are indistinguishable across network sizes. Exchange flux fidelity is agnostic to solver choice, with network size mattering only for intracellular interpretability. Transferring the developed model from fed-batch to continuous operation with fine-tuning outperforming other transfer learning variants. This is consistent with the metabolic structure being invariant to mode of operation. Predicted fluxes reveal growth rate in fed-batch, rather than operating mode, as the dominant axis of metabolic variation, and identify potential regime-shift signals to guide experimental design for continuous culture characterisation. These results chart a route towards digital models sufficiently grounded in first-principles knowledge, yet adaptive for deployment under regime shifts.
titleZh: 代谢知识引导的生物反应器模型：将补料分批工艺的知识迁移至连续生物制造
abstractZh: 中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞仍是单克隆抗体（mAb）制造的主要平台，不断增长的需求正推动该行业从补料分批运行转向连续运行。连续培养有望维持高细胞密度和高体积生产率，但其运行依赖可靠的实时监测、预测与控制。细胞内状态的可观测性有限，细胞外测量又较为稀疏，阻碍了这一目标的实现，使机制认识与预测模型的实际部署之间持续存在差距。本研究提出一种由代谢知识引导的mAb生产模型，将反应器层面和细胞内层面的质量衡算直接嵌入学习架构，同时避免预设动力学速率定律和显式稳态假设。由于守恒关系在不同运行模式下保持不变，这一表述为跨工况泛化提供了基于原理的结构先验，并将模型定位为连续生物过程的软传感器：推断未测量的细胞内通量，并提前一步预测细胞外浓度，以支持过程监测和控制。研究者对两种代谢网络规模与三种代谢优化策略进行了基准比较，发现不同网络规模下的浓度预测结果无可区分的差异。交换通量的保真度与求解器选择无关，网络规模仅影响细胞内过程的可解释性。将所开发的模型从补料分批运行迁移至连续运行时，微调的表现优于其他迁移学习方案。这与代谢结构不随运行模式改变的认识一致。预测通量显示，补料分批培养中的生长速率，而非运行模式，是代谢变化的主导维度；模型还识别出可能提示工况转换的信号，可为连续培养表征的实验设计提供指导。这些结果为构建既充分建立在第一性原理知识之上、又能适应工况转换下部署的数字模型提供了一条路径。

sourceTitle: Genetic control couples TGF β -independent pluripotent stem cell renewal to deterministic forward programming across germ layers
sourceAbstract: Reproducible and scalable manufacture of human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) derivatives requires control over expansion and differentiation. Transcription factor-mediated forward programming can place hiPSC differentiation under genetic control, but expansion still relies on extracellular growth-factor supplementation, increasing process complexity and operator dependence. Here we introduce GERALT ( G enetically E nhanced R enewal and A utonomous L ineage T ransdifferentiation), a push–pull genetic circuit assembled through targeted safe-harbour integration that couples NANOG-supported, TGF β -independent renewal to doxycycline-inducible lineage programming and simultaneous NANOG silencing. GERALT maintained pluripotency during extended TGF β withdrawal in both adherent and suspension culture, yet remained programmable towards myogenic, neuronal, and hepatic fates. Compared with the established OPTi-OX platform in myogenesis, GERALT enabled differentiation in simplified medium while canalising and accelerating commitment. GERALT also supported direct myogenic programming in suspension and enabled direct casting of hiPSCs into hydrogel followed by in-tissue programming, yielding electrically responsive engineered muscle tissues. These results extend genetic control upstream into stem cell renewal, facilitating deployment of new approach methodologies and other biomanufacturing applications.
titleZh: 遗传控制将不依赖TGFβ的多能干细胞自我更新与跨胚层的确定性正向编程相耦合
abstractZh: 要可重复、可规模化地制造人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）衍生细胞，需要控制其扩增与分化。转录因子介导的正向编程可使hiPSC分化受到遗传控制，但扩增仍依赖外源补充生长因子，从而增加工艺复杂性及对操作者的依赖。本研究提出GERALT，即遗传增强的自我更新与自主谱系转分化（Genetically Enhanced Renewal and Autonomous Lineage Transdifferentiation）。这是一种通过靶向安全港位点整合而组装的推拉式基因回路，将由NANOG支持、不依赖TGFβ的自我更新，与多西环素诱导的谱系编程及同步发生的NANOG沉默相耦合。在长时间撤除TGFβ的条件下，GERALT在贴壁培养与悬浮培养中均能维持多能性，同时仍可被编程为肌源性、神经元及肝细胞命运。在肌生成方面，与已建立的OPTi-OX平台相比，GERALT能够在简化培养基中实现分化，同时使命运决定过程更加定向并加快这一过程。GERALT还支持在悬浮培养中直接进行肌源性编程，并能将hiPSC直接浇注到水凝胶中，随后在组织内进行编程，获得能够对电刺激作出反应的工程化肌肉组织。这些结果将遗传控制向上游延伸至干细胞自我更新，有助于新方法学（new approach methodologies）及其他生物制造应用的实施。

sourceTitle: Multilevel metabolic engineering of Bacillus amyloliquefaciens for enhanced L-tyrosine production.
sourceAbstract: L-Tyrosine is a valuable aromatic amino acid with diverse applications. Although plasmid-based overexpression has markedly improved L-tyrosine production, the dependence on antibiotic selection and genetic instability under nonselective conditions limits its industrial applicability. To address these issues, this study employed a multi-level metabolic engineering strategy to enhance the L-tyrosine biosynthetic pathway at the genomic level in Bacillus amyloliquefaciens. First, an expression cassette containing the mutant prephenate dehydrogenase (TyrA I309A/E330V ) was inserted into the genome of the wild-type strain Z1. When the copy number reached three (strain Z4), L-tyrosine production reached 437.43 mg/L. Subsequently, the mutant DAHP synthase (AroA R27A/K38A ) was integrated, and the resulting two-copy strain Z7 increased L-tyrosine production to 591.29 mg/L. Systematic identification of rate-limiting steps showed that most pathway genes enhanced production to varying extents. A promoter in situ replacement strategy was then applied to construct strain Z21, which further increased the titer to 813.01 mg/L. Finally, by optimizing precursor supply, the engineered strain Z32 reached an L-tyrosine titer of 1079.94 mg/L. Overall, this plasmid-free and antibiotic-independent platform offers a promising strategy for stable biosynthesis of L-tyrosine and other aromatic amino acids in microbial cell factories.
titleZh: 以多层次代谢工程提高解淀粉芽孢杆菌的L-酪氨酸产量
abstractZh: L-酪氨酸是一种用途广泛的高价值芳香族氨基酸。虽然基于质粒的过表达已经明显提高了L-酪氨酸产量，但依赖抗生素筛选，以及在非选择性条件下存在遗传不稳定性，限制了其工业应用。为解决这些问题，本研究采用多层次代谢工程策略，在解淀粉芽孢杆菌（Bacillus amyloliquefaciens）的基因组层面增强L-酪氨酸生物合成途径。首先，将含有突变型预苯酸脱氢酶TyrA（I309A/E330V）的表达盒插入野生型菌株Z1的基因组。当拷贝数达到3个时，所得菌株Z4的L-酪氨酸滴度达到437.43 mg/L。随后整合突变型DAHP合酶AroA（R27A/K38A），所得双拷贝菌株Z7的L-酪氨酸滴度提高至591.29 mg/L。对限速步骤的系统性辨识表明，大多数途径基因都能不同程度地提高产量。接着，研究者通过启动子原位替换构建菌株Z21，使滴度进一步提高到813.01 mg/L。最后，通过优化前体供应，工程菌株Z32的L-酪氨酸滴度达到1079.94 mg/L。总体而言，这一无质粒、不依赖抗生素的平台，为微生物细胞工厂稳定生物合成L-酪氨酸及其他芳香族氨基酸提供了一种有前景的策略。
